title: Evidence Checkpoint Canonical Envelope Contract (Draft R2)
description: Outer canonical envelope schema wrapping an evidence checkpoint input payload with its RFC 8785 content-addressed SHA-256 digest.

envelope_version.description: Schema version of the canonical transport envelope.

payload.description: The exact checkpoint input payload object. Preimage for RFC 8785 canonical serialization and hashing.

envelope_manifest_digest.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest over the raw UTF-8 bytes produced by RFC 8785 canonical serialization of the payload object.
